analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 33.0 entering oversold territory, halting decline from 34.5 five days ago. CCI attempting rebound from extreme oversold at -131.8. MACD histogram remains worsening at -0.3422, but RSI's oversold exit attempt strengthens buy perspective. Volume at 1.44x 5-day average adds conviction to the move.
